This matter is taken up by hybrid mode.

2. Heard Mr. S.P. Das, learned counsel for the petitioner, Mr. S. Nayak, learned Additional Standing Counsel appearing for opposite party no.1 and Mr. Amitav Dash, learned counsel appearing for opposite party nos.2 and 3.
3.
The petitioner has filed this writ petition seeking direction to the opposite parties to release higher compensation in lieu of the acquisition of the land.

4. It is contended by learned counsel appearing for opposite party nos.2 and 3 that if the petitioner claims higher compensation, then he has to approach the appropriate authority under Section 3 G (5) of the NH Act, 1956, which has also been admitted by learned counsel for the petitioner.
5. In view of the above, this writ petition stands disposed of permitting the petitioner to pursue his remedy before the appropriate authority under the provisions of the NH Act, 1956.
